salesforceConsumerKey: consumer key of your Salesforce External Client App
driveParentFolderId: ID of the shared Google Drive folder that holds one folder per study tour
agendaTemplateId: ID of the Google Slides agenda template
googleChatSpace: URL of the team's Google Chat space (optional; can also be picked in Settings)
geminiSponsorKeySuffix: last characters of a sponsored Gemini key (optional; shows 'Gemini AI is paid by' in the footer)
